title: Public Relations Campaigns: From Planning to Execution
overview: Effective planning is crucial for any public relations (PR) program. A well-structured PR plan is essential for executing a professional and comprehensive campaign. Research shows that over 50% of new businesses fail within their first year, often due to inadequate planning and resources in their PR efforts. If you find it difficult to draft a PR plan or feel overwhelmed by the execution process, this course is designed for you. Through engaging and interactive sessions, you will be guided along a roadmap that equips you with the knowledge and skills needed to create and implement a successful PR campaign.
audience: This course is aimed at PR officers and other key personnel responsible for shaping and enhancing a positive image for their organization.
methodology: The course is structured around four learning pillars: concept learning (lectures and presentations), role-playing (group exercises), experience sharing (roundtable discussions), and real-world problem exposure and solutions.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Identify and define key PR concepts and differentiate them from advertising
Develop and execute a comprehensive PR plan
Recognize the contributions of PR campaigns to strategic management
Manage crises effectively using PR strategies
Understand the significance of organizational and corporate image
Evaluate the effectiveness of PR efforts
